name: line-alive-check-bot
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if ! command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl https://mise.run | sh; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"; cd ${containerWorkspaceFolder}; mise trust; mise install; mise run install; python -m pre_commit install'
